credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)
title: The last body is still alive, and it's crying. Please. Kill me . . . (highlight)

segments.say: The last body is still alive, and it's crying. *Please. Kill me.*
The team stops to rest and eat. Jin passes around food, and every one of them *chews*.
One minute later they are swaying on their feet. Jin smiles, says it's *just* a sleeping drug, and goes in alone.
At the warehouse two guards chat about girls and drinks, until Jin drops from the shadows and *wrecks* them.
Two guards, no alarms, and a plain padlock. Jin pops it open and walks *in*.
Inside is a magic circle written in blood. It only opens for *human* blood, so he cuts a guard and uses *that*.
The circle lights up red, and it turns out the guard wasn't *human* anymore.
The two knocked-out guards swell into red-eyed giants with muscles on top of their muscles. *Damn*.
Jin goes for the head. They get right back up. He goes for the heart. They *regenerate*.
Jin smirks. These are biological golems, forbidden magic, and each one has a core in the head, the heart, or the *abdomen*.
He checks them one at a time. Head, nothing. Heart, nothing. Only the abdomen is *left*.
He shatters the first core, then slices through the second, and the red glow finally *dies*.
Jin stabs through its core and says one word. *I will.*
Nobody would ever choose to become a golem, he says, and they get thrown away the second they change.
The full story is on our channel.
